editorial:
Imagine your favorite manga gets turned into a movie, but there is a huge secret: the author might have stolen the idea! That is exactly the chaos you get in this wild ride. You follow the Donbrothers as they get swept up in a movie production led by a pushy producer named Reiko. Haruka is stressed out because of the plagiarism rumors, and the whole filming process is a total disaster. It feels like a comedy of errors where nothing goes as planned, and even the Noto are getting in on the action. The vibe is loud, colorful, and completely unpredictable, which is exactly what makes it so much fun to watch.

What really hits the mark here is the chemistry between the characters and the sheer randomness of the plot. The action is snappy, and the twists keep you guessing until the very end. While the story is a bit messy at times, that just adds to the charm. If you love goofy heroes and over-the-top energy, you will have a blast.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the producer Reiko was actually using the movie shoot to create a real-life conflict to spark more drama. After a chaotic battle, the truth about the manga comes out, but the Donbrothers manage to save the day regardless of the plagiarism scandal. Everything wraps up with the team realizing that their friendship is more important than the movie's success, ending on a high, funny note that fits the series perfectly.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy action and colorful characters.
